name: Cast to TV
description: Mirrors the complete RerunTV window or a selected desktop display to one Chromecast/Google TV, with lower-latency program-only casting as a fallback.

ipc.why: scans the LAN (mDNS) for Chromecast/Google TV devices to list in the settings panel
lists the RerunTV window and desktop displays so the selected complete rendered output can be mirrored
grants one-time capture of the selected app window or display with app audio or Windows system-loopback audio
connects to the Chromecast/Google TV device you selected from the scan
closes the connection to the cast device
loads whatever is currently airing onto the connected cast device
streams encoded RerunTV window frames from the renderer to the selected receiver
starts whole-app RerunTV mirroring on the selected receiver
stops whole-app RerunTV mirroring and releases its capture stream
stops playback on the cast device
sets the cast device's receiver volume
turns on/off automatically keeping the cast device in sync with channel changes and drift
receives the currently-playing local file/position from the renderer so it can be served to the cast device
reports connection/casting status back to the settings panel

net.why: serves either the complete live RerunTV mirror or the currently-airing local video to the selected Cast receiver. Beyond this port the plugin also makes raw LAN connections that this list cannot gate: multicast mDNS on UDP 5353 to find Cast devices, and a TLS connection to the chosen receiver on TCP 8009 to control it

system.why: captures either the RerunTV application window or a selected desktop display for mirroring (screen contents are sent to the receiver you selected)
